verdict.rationale: Zero is a self-hostable AI email app, so publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence shows no public HTTP API and no OpenAPI or equivalent schema. The only API-adjacent surface is MCP.md, a prose capability list with no endpoint schema and no docs site. The MCP server belongs to a different story and does not count as a downloadable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
